title: Heralded Free-Electron Writing of the Most Subradiant State in an Atomic Array
summary: The most subradiant eigenstate of a finite subwavelength atomic chain in free space, protected by strongly suppressed radiative decay, offers a powerful resource for photon storage, quantum sensing, and many-body quantum optics. Yet its optical preparation is hindered by the simultaneous need to match a wave vector outside the light cone and a nonuniform envelope. Here, we show that a free electron can overcome these constraints: its velocity sets the imprinted wave vector, while the trajectory of the diffracting wave packet shapes the excitation envelope.
